item.title: TikTok Adds Voice Notes and Image Carousels in Comments
item.dc:creator: Andrew Hutchinson
item.description: TikTok is adding voice notes and image carousels as new comment options, giving brands more creative ways to join conversations.

item.title: Instagram Tests Reels Templates for Collaborative Posts
item.description: Instagram is testing new Reels templates designed for collaborative posting between creators and brands.

item.title: LinkedIn Reports Record Video Engagement Among Gen Z
item.dc:creator: Emma Wiltshire
item.content:encoded:
LinkedIn says video posts are driving record engagement from Gen Z members, with watch time up sharply year over year.

Marketers should take note of the shift toward short-form professional video.
